messages.author: f86305296543d08f
messages.subject: Incompatible library version?
parts:
Hi,

I have R version 3.4.4 and recently installed INLA via
install.packages("INLA", repos=c(getOption("repos"), INLA="https://inla.r-inla-download.org/R/stable"), dep=TRUE)
This seemed to work fine.

However, I have now run into the following error message:

dyld: Library not loaded: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.5/Resources/lib/libR.dylib
  Referenced from: /Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla
  Reason: Incompatible library version: inla requires version 3.5.0 or later, but libR.dylib provides version 3.4.0
sh: line 1: 49110 Abort trap: 6           '/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/3.4/Resources/library/INLA/bin/mac/64bit/inla.run' -b -s -v '/private/var/folders/59/72wt4vqn5cv1l5lbfmxhkjc00000gn/T/RtmpMqOP6U/file4c661b5e233e/Model.ini' > '/private/var/folders/59/72wt4vqn5cv1l5lbfmxhkjc00000gn/T/RtmpMqOP6U/file4c661b5e233e/Logfile.txt'
Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() : 

For reasons related to a different package, I would prefer to stick with R 3.4.4 if possible. In this case, is there a different version of INLA that I should install instead? If so, which one and where can I find it? I am running Mac High Sierra.

Thanks for your help!

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Incompatible library version?
parts:

(I think), by removing the INLA package, and install it again,
not in rstudio, but in R directly.

can you try that?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Incompatible library version?
parts:
On Wed, 2019-02-06 at 15:04 -0800, Miranda wrote:
> I decided to just update R to the latest version and switch to the
> older version as needed for other purposes.
> Thanks!

thx. there is no way back moving to 3.5, and we do not compile new versions for 3.4 anymore, so
its likely the easiest choice. the library format is different so you'll need to reinstall all packages doing the move
